hosea.9.p1.b1.text: Do not rejoice, O Israel, with exultation like the nations, for you have played the harlot against your God …

hosea.9.p1.b2.text: They will not remain in the land of the LORD; Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.

hosea.9.p1.b3.text: The prophet is called a fool, and the inspired man insane …

hosea.9.p1.b4.text: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the firstfruits of the fig tree in its first season. …

hosea.9.p1.b5.text: Ephraim’s glory will fly away like a bird …

hosea.9.p1.b6.text: Ephraim is struck down; their root is withered; they cannot bear fruit. … My God will reject them because they have not obeyed Him; and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
